description: This file defines a Console class providing console UI utilities, including text rendering with ANSI colors, cursor control, and word wrapping, used for console-based text rendering and interaction.

classes.name: Console
classes.description: A utility class for console UI support, including text rendering, cursor control, and ANSI styling.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Sends an escape sequence to the console and optionally reads a reply.

methods.name: get_width
methods.description: Returns the console width or a default maximum width.

methods.name: get_cursor_xy
methods.description: Retrieves the current cursor x, y coordinates.

methods.name: set_cursor_xy
methods.description: Sets the cursor position to specified x, y coordinates.

methods.name: raw_write
methods.description: Writes raw text to the specified output stream.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays text with optional line feed and error stream.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Indents text by a specified margin.

methods.name: dedent
methods.description: Removes common indentation and heading newlines from text.

methods.name: render_text
methods.description: Renders text with ANSI colors and styles.

methods.name: wordwrap
methods.description: Wraps text to fit within console width, considering ANSI escape sequences.
